title: Reliability Flightdeck: Initiative Synchronizer & Runbook
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build an Initiative Synchronizer feature inside the Reliability Flightdeck to automatically align initiative timelines, SLI target changes, and error-budget allocations across teams. The synchronizer will: 1) ingest SLI/SLAs and current error-budget burn rates from telemetry; 2) propose rebalancing actions (throttle rollouts, extend canaries, recommend capacity reservations); 3) provide a one-click runbook to execute gating actions (pause rollouts, trigger auto-rollbacks, notify oncall); and 4) surface conflicts between initiatives or pooled error budgets in a consolidated timeline view. This ticket defines the PM scope, acceptance criteria, UX review checkpoints, and integration touchpoints with Eng and Console teams.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Synchronizer reads SLI and burn-rate inputs for at least three SLOs (latency p95, request success rate, model throughput) from production telemetry; 2) UI shows consolidated initiative timeline with calculated error-budget runway and recommended actions; 3) Operator can trigger at least three gating actions from UI that call existing rollback/throttle APIs; 4) Automation rules include an opt-out per-initiative and log audit entries to the customer's audit stream; 5) End-to-end tests exercise decision logic for high/medium/low burn scenarios and pass in CI.
success_metrics: 1) Reduction in number of manual intervention rollouts by 40% within first quarter after launch; 2) Mean time to mitigation for SLO breaches reduced from current baseline by 25%; 3) 50% of teams adopt Synchronizer suggestions in pilot; 4) No security or data-leak incidents in Private deployments during pilot.
deliverables: Console UI: Flightdeck timeline and actions
Runbook templates and playbook for oncall
notes: We are treating this as an incremental automation layer—first phase focuses on visibility + manual trigger of recommendations, phase two automates low-risk adjustments. Scoped to Hosted and Dedicated initially; Private/VPC will be gated by security review. Will reuse existing telemetry ingestion and rollback APIs to minimize infra changes.
